The campaign ran from 00:00 Monday, December 7 to 00:00 Saturday, December 19, Nairobi time, and has ended. It spent **$374.26** of the $400 budget, served **297,549 impressions** and drew **165 link clicks**.

## Recap (X-reported)

| Ad group | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | Cost per click |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trial for yourself (posts …0917, …8751, …9668) | $246.87 | 202,259 | 109 | $2.26 |
| Christmas invitation (post …5355) | $127.40 | 95,290 | 56 | $2.28 |
| **Total** | **$374.26** | **297,549** | **165** | **$2.27** |

**What we can't see:** X has no pixel on tervamoth.com, so it recorded no trial starts. The 165 clicks are visits to the landing page. Your own records of completed trial starts are the real result, and only you can see them. Clicks on the invitation ad also aren't trial starts. At most, some of those visitors sent an invitation, and a friend still has to start their own trial by December 24.

## Setup
- **Structure:** one campaign with two ad groups, so the invitation and the trial for yourself are reported separately. Both ad groups were set to get as many link clicks as possible. They used only your 4 approved posts.
- **Audience:** both groups were limited to Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana and South Africa, and to iPhone and Android devices. They were also aimed at people interested in anime or horror and thriller. X doesn't let me target phones only by excluding tablets, so a small share of the impressions may have gone to iPads or Android tablets.

## Changes during the flight
- **Only one adjustment:** on December 16, I raised the daily budget for the trial-for-yourself group from $22 to $28. It was spending below pace, and that group had the most clicks.
- **No ads paused:** the cost per click was about $2.04–$2.30 for all 4 posts. The differences between them were in how often people clicked, not in price. So I didn't pause any.
- **After the flight:** I set the campaign to paused so it can't restart.
- **Unspent budget:** about $26 went unspent, because the ad groups didn't use all of their daily budgets.

## Post-level findings (through December 16)
- **Best click rate:** the post with eligibility details (…8751: "For new subscribers in Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana and South Africa, only on iPhone…"), at about 0.8% and 53 clicks. Readers who click it already know they qualify, so it may lead to more trial starts than the click count alone suggests.
- **Invitation post** (…5355): about 0.6%, 48 clicks.
- **Christmas-mystery post** (…0917): about 0.45%, 24 clicks.
- **"7 days free" post** (…9668): weakest at about 0.2%, 11 clicks.

Compare these figures with your trial-start records for December 7–18. If you can see where trials came from, separate trials people started for themselves from those started through invitations.
